items.title: Fix: Prevent settings overwrite during UI init by guarding save_settings with _loading_settings and clearing it after load. Idle Zones divisions now restore reliably (signal blocking + UI sync). Added multi-zone selection cycling and persistence. Added test_idle_zones_verification.py for end-to-end checks. Files: app/MAIN_FILE_SINGLE_CAM.py, app/idle_zones_widget.py, test_idle_zones_verification.py.

Feature: Added Idle Zones tab with a graphical pan/tilt range selector tied to live limits. Selected zone can be used as the target-loss return when idle mode is enabled (Rest behavior), with persisted divisions/selection settings. Files: app/MAIN_FILE_SINGLE_CAM.py, app/idle_zones_widget.py.

Critical Fix: Eliminated Auto-Tracking 'Snap-Back' by gating Target Lost hold/idle logic with tracking_active (prevents stale last_known_pan/tilt from overriding Go Home or Manual positions). Go Home and Manual no longer set _user_initiated_stop so auto-tracking can re-engage on new detections. Restored hold_window/time_since_seen locals and added test_snapback_fix.py to prevent regression. Files: app/MAIN_FILE_SINGLE_CAM.py, test_snapback_fix.py.

Critical Fix: Removed _complete_go_home unconditional re-enable callback. Fixed dual-port _home_step guard to check bus_ser too. Fixed duplicate IO send bug in dual-port (try/except/else was double-sending S/M/F/L/R/G to Nano). Bus servo failures now always logged (not gated by debug checkbox). Files: app/MAIN_FILE_SINGLE_CAM.py.
Finetuning: Increased 'Go Home' speed (5%→10% default) and speed limit (8→25 deg/sec) for better responsiveness. Updated default Home Tilt to 80° per user request.
Finetuning: Improved auto-track stability with debounce (0.5s) on target loss. Added detailed debug logging for Bus Servo write failures in Dual Port mode.

Critical Fix: Stop Tracking is the only explicit stop. Auto-tracking re-engagement respects _user_initiated_stop and will not resume until Start Tracking clears it. Files: app/MAIN_FILE_SINGLE_CAM.py.

Critical Fix: Resolved UI limitation where Home Tilt/Pan inputs were clamped to default ranges (e.g. 70) even when limits were increased. load_settings now updates widget ranges before setting values.

Critical Fix: Tracking calculations gated by tracking_active; Target Lost hold/idle logic now respects tracking_active to prevent stale last_known_* from overriding Go Home/Manual positions. Files: app/MAIN_FILE_SINGLE_CAM.py.
Behavior Presets dock now keeps a stable objectName to prevent saveState/restoreState crashes when layouts are saved or restored.
